title: mirabilis hirsuta
intro: Mirabilis hirsuta, commonly known as desert holly or hairy four o'clock, is a species of flowering plant in the four o'clock family (Nyctaginaceae). The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, treating wounds, and showing antimicrobial properties. Mirabilis hirsuta is known to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
